newsitem.title: USA: Investment Research upgrades gold view to neutral.
newsitem.headline: Investment Research upgrades gold view to neutral.

text.p: Cincinnati-based Investment Research Institute upgraded its view on gold to neutral from bearish, the firm said Friday in a report.

"April gold futures have found a bottom at $340/ounce and have been able to reverse a three-month downtrend that has kept gold constrained by its 10-day and 20-day moving averages," analyst Joseph Sunderman said in the report.
COMEX April gold futures settled at $365.10 an ounce, up $4.10 on Friday.
In the report, Sunderman also noted that sentiment toward gold remains largely bearish, with one sentiment survey showing bullishness at 34 percent.
"With April gold futures 10-day moving average crossing above the 20-day moving average amid a skeptical environment, we are revising our stance for gold from bearish to neutral," Sunderman said.
April gold futures bottomed at $338.50 on February 12. On February 25, the futures' 10-day moving average closed above the 20-day moving average.
